parameter_limit_ablation.change: remove the optimizable-parameter count ceiling from prompts and policy validation
parameter_limit_ablation.reuse: identical demand tapes and previously optimized baseline policies
parameter_limit_ablation.interpretation: user-requested exploratory ablation after reviewing the previous results; no fresh confirmatory test set

configuration.demand_observation: full past realized demand, including unmet demand, available equally to all policies
configuration.timing: old arrivals -> observe current lead-time quote -> order -> current demand -> holding/lost-sales cost
configuration.random_lead: iid uniform on {3,9}, quote known before ordering, overtaking allowed, sampled by calendar period even for zero orders
configuration.pipeline: old arrivals in future periods 1 through max_lead-1; aggregate by arrival date
configuration.policy_information: generator parameters known, current/future demand and future lead quotes unavailable, no horizon/time index
configuration.steady_caveat: finite stochastic burn-in approximates stationary inventory; demand itself starts exactly stationary
configuration.cold_start: actual stationary demand from period zero, no free zero-demand planning periods
configuration.same_paths_across_horizons: nested prefixes of a single maximum-length tape; no resampling when horizon changes
configuration.selection: optimizer and EOH parent selection use train only; one final candidate per independent run frozen before holdout
configuration.holdout_reporting: all scenarios and all runs, no test-driven selection of favorable environments or policies

evolution.feedback: compact train-only demand summary and processed scored-window feedback

horizon_refit_extension.scenario: positive AR latent rho=0.8, fixed lead6
horizon_refit_extension.priority: after all 18 primary runs, within global API budget

configuration.PIL_label: projected inventory level, an adaptation used for the requested projected base-stock comparator; random-lead continuation assumptions disclosed
configuration.baseline_tuning: train only, deterministic conditional QMC draws, train-only integration-accuracy checks
configuration.uncertainty: paired whole-path bootstrap; paths independent, within-path periods and horizon prefixes dependent
